notes: Release date 2026-05-28 from the newsroom index "May 28, 2026 - Introducing Claude Opus 4.8"; OpenRouter lists claude-opus-4.8 and 4.8-fast created 2026-05-27 (one-day listing lag). Prose carries no absolute vendor benchmark numbers - the entire capability table is image-only, so all vendor rows are pending with vision reads in notes. Honesty claim: about 4x less likely than its predecessor to let flaws in code it wrote pass unremarked. Alignment: misaligned-behavior rates substantially lower than 4.7, similar to Mythos Preview (chart image 40343dc4). Also launched: dynamic workflows in Claude Code (hundreds of parallel subagents, codebase-scale migrations); effort control UI in claude.ai/Cowork; Messages API system entries mid-task without breaking prompt cache. Pricing unchanged USD 5/25; fast mode USD 10/50. Forward-looking: Mythos-class general release "in the coming weeks" (Project Glasswing). Customer quotes not turned into rows: Super-Agent benchmark only model completing every case end-to-end; CursorBench exceeds prior Opus at every effort level (no numbers); Databricks Genie 61% cheaper token cost vs 4.7; Hebbia citation-precision gains.
